title: Every Desmos Trick for the SAT, Explained
description:
Every SAT math question lets you use Desmos, the graphing calculator built into Bluebook. Here are 11 ways to use it on real SAT question types, each shown on an SAT-style example, plus when NOT to use it.

You'll learn how to use Desmos to:
• Solve equations and systems by graphing
• Count solutions and find x-intercepts and vertices
• Use sliders for "what is the value of k" questions
• Check inequalities, run regressions from tables, and test equivalent expressions
• Evaluate functions and find the mean and median of a data set

All practice questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions.
